title: The Grace Period on a Certificate of Deposit, Under the Terms of Account
content:
After a certificate matures, the owner is given a short period in which the balance may be moved, added to or redirected without penalty. These are the terms of that period on every tier of the Certificates of Deposit line.

## What each tier allows during grace

| Tier | Length of the grace period, calendar days | Deposits accepted during grace | Smallest single grace deposit, USD | Most added in total during one grace period, USD | Part of the balance may be withdrawn | Owner may renew into a different tier | Balance withdrawn during grace earns interest for the grace days |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 6-Month Certificate | 10 | yes | 100.00 | 250000.00 | yes | yes | no |
| 11-Month No-Penalty Certificate | 10 | yes | 100.00 | 250000.00 | yes | yes | no |
| 12-Month Certificate | 10 | yes | 100.00 | 250000.00 | yes | yes | no |
| 18-Month Bump-Up Certificate | 10 | yes | 100.00 | 250000.00 | yes | yes | no |
| 36-Month Certificate | 10 | yes | 100.00 | 250000.00 | yes | yes | no |
| 60-Month Certificate | 10 | yes | 100.00 | 250000.00 | yes | yes | no |

The terms are uniform across the line: ten calendar days, deposits of at least 100.00 USD up to a total of 250000.00 USD, withdrawal of part or all of the balance, and a free choice of the tier the certificate renews into.

## Illustrative reading of the terms

Two deposits of 100.00 USD and 60.00 USD offered during one grace period: the first is accepted under the smallest-deposit figure, the second is not, because 60.00 USD is below 100.00 USD. The figure binds on each single deposit, while the 250000.00 USD figure binds on the total of them.

A balance of 40000.00 USD withdrawn on the fourth day of grace is paid out as it stood at maturity. Because no tier of the line lets grace days earn interest on a balance that is withdrawn, those four days add nothing to it.
